title: Elin Harrow and the Broken Memory

participants.unknown_label: the shaken woman near the hearth

paragraphs.text: Elin Harrow sits close to the Grey Road Inn hearth with a blanket drawn around her shoulders. Firelight warms the room, but it has not reached her hands.
She watches the door whenever the common room goes quiet. The torn green sash in her lap is twisted tight enough to leave marks in her fingers.
When the old shrine is mentioned, her answer thins into breath before it becomes words.

on_success.text: Your read of frightened witnesses catches the shape of the omission: she is not avoiding the road. She is avoiding the moment the shrine bell sounded.

knowledge_grants.title: Elin avoids the shrine bell
knowledge_grants.summary: Elin's fear gathers around the moment the old shrine bell sounded during the attack.

result.text: Elin closes her eyes. "The wheel," she says. "I heard the wheel split before I understood anyone was shouting."
result.summary: Elin remembers the wagon wheel cracking before the attackers reached the caravan.

relationship_writes.reason: A concrete first memory steadies the conversation.

result.text: The sash is hers, not a trophy. A roadward knot is still tied at one end, the kind Dunmere wagoners use so a child can find the right cart in market fog.
result.summary: Elin's torn sash still bears a roadward knot from the attacked caravan.

knowledge_grants.title: Elin's sash bears a roadward knot
knowledge_grants.summary: The torn green sash Elin holds came from the caravan and still bears a roadward knot used by Dunmere wagoners.

on_success.text: Her fear sharpens at the shrine, but not with recognition of a person. It is the memory of everyone stopping together, listening to something she could not hear.
on_success.summary: Elin fears the shared pause more than any single attacker.

knowledge_grants.title: Elin fears the shared pause
knowledge_grants.summary: Elin's fear centers on the attackers stopping together as if they heard the same unheard command.

relationship_writes.reason: The player reads the fear without cornering her.

on_failure.text: She is too frayed to read cleanly. The obvious part remains: shrine talk leaves her frightened and brittle.
on_failure.summary: Elin's fear remains hard to separate from shock.

relationship_writes.reason: The attempted read lands as scrutiny.

result.text: Elin rubs the knot flat. "My brother tied it. Said the road fog steals everything except a good knot." The name does not come with it; grief closes around that part.
result.summary: The roadward knot belonged to Elin's family wagon, but she does not give a new name.

relationship_writes.reason: The player noticed a personal detail without exploiting it.
relationship_writes.summary: Elin softens a little when the knot is handled as memory rather than evidence.

preview.text: You spend the dialogue beat giving Elin permission to stop forcing the memory, trading immediate answers for trust.

no_check_result.text: Elin lets out a breath that sounds almost borrowed. She adds no new clue, but she no longer looks ready to bolt from the hearth.
no_check_result.summary: Elin steadies when not pushed for more.

relationship_writes.reason: The player chose reassurance over extraction.
relationship_writes.summary: Elin seems more willing to trust you.

committed_social_moves.label: Press gently about the shrine bell

preview.text: You spend the dialogue beat trying to bring Elin back to the shrine bell without making the memory feel like a trap.

assistance.text: If you learned about the roadward knot or the first sound, you can anchor the question in what she has already offered.

on_success.npc_response: Elin's voice drops. "The bell rang once. They all stopped. Not like men obeying a captain. Like hands leaving a string when the pluck is done."
on_success.result_summary: Elin connects the attack to a single ring from the old shrine bell.

knowledge_grants.title: The shrine bell stopped the attack
knowledge_grants.summary: Elin remembered the attackers stopping together after a single ring from the old shrine bell.

relationship_writes.reason: The player pressed gently enough for Elin to stay with the memory.
relationship_writes.summary: Elin trusts you a little more with what she remembers.

relationship_writes.reason: The shrine-bell memory opened after a careful approach.

on_failure.npc_response: The word bell makes her fold inward. "No. I do not have that part anymore." Her gaze fixes on the fire until the question dies there.
on_failure.result_summary: Elin withdraws from the shrine-bell memory.

relationship_writes.reason: The shrine-bell question landed too sharply.
The question made Elin feel cornered.
relationship_writes.summary: Elin grows more guarded around you.

committed_social_moves.label: Spend time on the first sound

preview.text: You spend the dialogue beat staying with the first sound long enough to draw the memory into a fuller shape.

assistance.text: Because this continues from an available Clarifying Question, the authored follow-up uses advantage.

on_success.npc_response: "The wheel split clean," Elin says. "Then the quiet came all at once, before the bell."
on_success.result_summary: Elin places the broken wheel before the unnatural quiet and the shrine bell.

knowledge_grants.title: The wheel split before the quiet
knowledge_grants.summary: Elin placed the wagon wheel splitting before the unnatural quiet and the shrine bell.

relationship_writes.reason: The player spent time with a concrete sensory memory.

on_failure.npc_response: The memory breaks into pieces again. Elin can name the wheel, but not what followed it.
on_failure.result_summary: Elin cannot hold the first-sound memory long enough to deepen it.

relationship_writes.reason: Staying too long on the first sound strains the memory.

committed_social_moves.label: Accuse her of holding something back

preview.text: You spend the dialogue beat forcing the issue. This may produce a reaction, but it risks closing Elin down.

on_success.npc_response: "I am holding back panic," she snaps, then catches herself. "The bell. The bell is the part I cannot keep buried."
on_success.result_summary: A hard challenge shakes loose the shrine-bell thread, at a cost.

knowledge_grants.title: Elin named the shrine bell under pressure
knowledge_grants.summary: Under pressure, Elin admitted the shrine bell is the memory she has been avoiding.

relationship_writes.reason: The challenge was direct enough to cut through panic.
relationship_writes.summary: Elin recognizes that you will not let the dangerous part pass unnoticed.

on_failure.npc_response: Her face goes still. "Then ask someone braver." The blanket rises to her chin, and the conversation narrows to the space between you.
on_failure.result_summary: Elin refuses to continue under accusation.

relationship_writes.summary: Elin is visibly less willing to help after being accused.

committed_social_moves.label: Turn the memory toward the road

preview.text: You spend the dialogue beat shaping the fragments into the next place to look rather than extracting another detail from her.

no_check_result.text: Elin points not to the main road, but to the low path behind the inn. "If the bell called them back, they would have taken the hollow way."
no_check_result.summary: Elin points toward the hollow path behind the inn as the safer next lead.

knowledge_grants.title: The hollow path behind the inn
knowledge_grants.summary: Elin believes the attackers would have returned by the hollow path behind the Grey Road Inn if the shrine bell called them back.

relationship_writes.reason: The player turned the memory toward actionable direction instead of another demand.

success_behavior.text: Elin answers in a small, careful way, but the answer stays within what she has already given you.
success_behavior.summary: The unauthored question receives a limited answer without adding a major discovery.

failure_behavior.text: The question lands too far from what she can hold. Elin's attention returns to the fire, and the opening closes.
failure_behavior.summary: The constrained fallback attempt does not produce useful new ground.

behavior.text: You let the fire and the inn's careful quiet take the conversation back from her.
You leave Elin by the hearth and return to the Grey Road Inn common room with the memory fragments you chose to carry.

relationship_writes.reason: Ending the conversation lowers immediate pressure.

behavior.text: Elin's warning follows you out from the hearth: do not listen if the road listens back.

summary_behavior.player_summary_template: Elin shared memory fragments about the broken wheel, the old shrine bell, and the hollow path without exposing hidden-only notes.

npc_profile_recap.text: Elin Harrow is a survivor of the Grey Road attack whose memories gather around a broken wheel, a torn green sash, and the old shrine bell.
